Venue: Binance
Headline: During the Promotion Period, complete designated tasks on trading, referral, Earn, Square, and other products to earn USDC rewards. Once a task is completed, rewards…

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Fellow Binancians,
Black Friday × Thanksgiving — THE BIG BINANCE BONANZA is officially here!
During the Promotion Period, complete designated tasks on trading, referral, Earn, Square, and other products to earn USDC rewards. Once a task is completed, rewards will be accumulated toward your campaign progress. Reach the corresponding reward tier to claim rewards for that tier, with a maximum of 100 USDC per user. The total campaign prize pool is worth 1,000,000 USDC. Rewards are available on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-25 10:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-08 23:59 (UTC)
Redemption Period: 2026-11-25 10:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-14 23:59 (UTC)
Join Now
## How to Participate
Access the Campaign: Log in to your Binance account and complete Identity Verification (KYC). Then visit the campaign page to participate.
Complete Tasks: Complete designated tasks on trading, Earn, Square, and other products, or invite friends to participate in the campaign to earn corresponding USDC rewards.
Accumulate Rewards: After successfully completing a task, rewards will be accumulated toward your campaign progress. Continue completing tasks to unlock higher reward tiers.
Claim Rewards: Once your accumulated rewards reach a tier’s threshold, you can claim the rewards for that tier.
## Please Note:
Rewards will be distributed on a first-come, first-served basis until the prize pool is exhausted.
Eligible users can visit the Rewards Hub to redeem their token voucher rewards.
Users must claim their rewards through the Binance App (Download Now).
## Tiered Rewards
During the Promotion Period, the USDC rewards users earn by completing tasks will continue to accumulate. Once the accumulated rewards reach a threshold, users can claim the corresponding rewards.
Progress Tier | Total Claimable Rewards (in Token Vouchers)
Threshold 1 | 5 USDC
Threshold 2 | 10 USDC
Threshold 3 | 20 USDC
Threshold 4 | 35 USDC
Threshold 5 | 55 USDC
Threshold 6 | 75 USDC
Threshold 7 | 90 USDC
Threshold 8 | 100 USDC
## Example:
User A reaches Threshold 1 and is eligible to claim 5 USDC. They can complete more tasks to reach Threshold 2, and claim an additional 5 USDC (bringing the total reward amount to 10 USDC). The same applies to subsequent thresholds, with rewards claimed incrementally until the prize pool is exhausted. The maximum cumulative reward is capped at 100 USDC per user.
## Campaign Tasks
The campaign page will display available tasks based on users' regions and product eligibility. Please refer to the campaign page for the specific completion requirements and reset rules.
Task Mechanism | Eligible Users | Completion Requirements | Reward per Completion (in Token Vouchers) | Reset Rules
Welcome Gift | All campaign participants | Visit the campaign page | 0.88 USDC | None
Daily Tasks | All campaign participants | Access designated pages or share the campaign through task links. Campaign tasks refresh daily. | 0.05 USDC | Daily
Core Tasks – First-Time Users | Users who have not completed their first deposit before the Promotion Period | Net Deposit at least $50 equivalent through Fiat Deposit , Buy Crypto , or P2P , and maintain the net deposit amount for at least 48 hours | 0.66 USDC | None
Users who have not completed their first Earn subscription before the Promotion Period | Subscribe at least $100 USDC to Earn products and maintain the position continuously for 72 hours | 0.66 USDC | None
Users who have not completed their first Convert trade before the Promotion Period | Complete a first Convert trade with at least $100 equivalent （Buy orders only) | 0.66 USDC | None
Users who have not completed their first bStocks trade before the Promotion Period | Complete a first bStocks trade with at least $100 equivalent (Buy orders only) | 0.66 USDC | None
Users who have not completed their first TradFi trade before the Promotion Period | Complete a first TradFi trade with at least $500 equivalent (Buy orders only) | 0.66 USDC | None
Users who have not completed their first Futures trade before the Promotion Period | Complete a first Futures trade with at least $500 equivalent (excluding TradFi; Buy orders only) | 0.66 USDC | None
Users who have not completed their first Spot trade before the Promotion Period | Complete a first Spot trade on any non-zero-fee trading pairs with at least $150 equivalent (excluding bStocks; Buy orders only) | 0.66 USDC | None
Core Tasks – New and Existing Users | All campaign participants | Complete Spot trades on any non-zero-fee trading pairs with at least $1,200 equivalent (Buy orders only) | 0.88 USDC | None
All campaign participants | Complete Spot trades on any non-zero-fee trading pairs with at least $5,000 equivalent (Buy orders only) | 2.88 USDC | None
All campaign participants | Complete Spot trades on any non-zero-fee trading pairs with at least $12,000 equivalent (Buy orders only) | 4.88 USDC | None
All campaign participants | Complete Futures trades with at least $5,000 equivalent (Buy orders only) | 1 USDC | None
All campaign participants | Complete Futures trades with at least $10,000 equivalent (Buy orders only) | 1.88 USDC | None
All campaign participants | Complete Futures trades with at least $100,000 equivalent (Buy orders only) | 10.88 USDC | None
All campaign participants | Complete Futures trades with at least $300,000 equivalent (Buy orders only) | 32.88 USDC | None
Users must meet the qualifying conditions for Earn and Deposit Tasks before the campaign ends, while the required 72-hour or 48-hour holding period may extend beyond the campaign period, provided the qualifying amount is maintained throughout; eligible rewards must be claimed within the specified Redemption Period, otherwise they will expire.
Daily Tasks: The available tasks and daily reward limits are subject to what is displayed on each user's campaign page. Daily Light Task limits reset at 00:00 UTC (08:00 UTC+8). Each individual task is generally valid for 24 hours from the time it becomes available. Near the end of the campaign, the task countdown timer will prevail. Users who join the campaign late will not receive tasks from previous days.
## Invite Friends to Earn USDC Rewards
During the Promotion Period, share your exclusive campaign referral link / referral code with friends who have not yet registered with Binance. Each friend must register through this link / referral code and complete all of the following tasks during the campaign period:
Log in to the Binance App at least once;
Deposit at least $50 equivalent in net deposits through Fiat Deposit, Buy Crypto, or P2P, and maintain the net deposit amount for at least 48 hours;
Accumulate at least $100 equivalent in trading volume through Convert and/or Spot.
Once your invited friends have completed all the above requirements and passed the eligibility and risk reviews, 4.28 USDC per qualified friend will be added to your accumulated campaign rewards (subject to the remaining prize pool).
Referral rewards will be unlocked after the invited friend completes all tasks and passes the review.
Campaign rewards will be distributed through the Rewards Hub after users reach the corresponding withdrawal threshold and pass the eligibility review. The exact distribution time is subject to the campaign page and system notifications.
When users visit the campaign page for the first time, the system will automatically generate a referral code or select one from their existing referral codes and associate it with this campaign. Only new users who register through this link / referral code will be counted.
Each user can receive referral rewards for a maximum of 10 qualified friends. Rewards are distributed on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Terms and Conditions
Only users who complete identity verification and confirm their participation during the Promotion Period can qualify for rewards in the Promotions. The products or features referred to above may not be available in your region. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance services in each country from which the services are accessed.
This Promotion is not open to residents or citizens of the United States, the United Kingdom, the European Economic Area (all 30 member states), Hong Kong, Singapore, or any other jurisdiction on Binance's List of Prohibited Countries. For the avoidance of doubt, any content, posts, entries, or submissions made by users from these jurisdictions — however submitted or tagged — will not be counted, considered, or eligible for any reward, recognition, or prize. Binance reserves the right to verify the jurisdiction of any participant and to disregard any entry at its sole discretion.
Spot zero-fee trading pairs are not eligible for this Promotion.
The following Convert trading pairs do not count toward this Promotion: FDUSD/USDT, USDC/USDT, TUSD/USDT, U/USDT, BUSD/USDT, USDP/USDT, DAI/USDT, GUSD/USDT, EURS/USDT, USDN/USDT, RSV/USDT, U/USDC, USDC/BUSD, BUSD/USDP, USDC/TUSD, DAI/USDC, FDUSD/TUSD, DAI/TUSD, FDUSD/USDC, DAI/FDUSD, AEUR/EUR, BUSD/FDUSD, and EUR/EURI.
Any reference to “$” means United States dollars, unless otherwise stated.
Sub-accounts do not participate in the Promotion as independent accounts. Trading volume from sub-accounts and margin accounts will not be counted toward the main account.
Users may be subject to Binance’s risk assessment procedures for each reward or use of a product. Users must pass the relevant risk assessment to be eligible to receive the reward or use the product.
Binance will use the price of the USDC trading pair at the time of each trade to calculate the value of trades completed during its Promotion Period. If a cryptocurrency does not have a USDC trading pair, its value will be determined through conversion into another token or coin with a USDC trading pair.
Users must claim their threshold rewards on the campaign page within 6 days after the Campaign ends. If a threshold reward expires before it is claimed, no replacement reward will be issued. Token voucher rewards will be credited to the user's Rewards Hub within 48 hours after the user reaches the threshold and claims the reward. Learn how to redeem token vouchers.
USDC token vouchers are valid for 14 days from the date of issuance. Users must redeem them before the expiration date. If a voucher is not redeemed before its expiration date, it will become invalid, and no replacement voucher or other reward will be issued. Learn how to redeem token vouchers.
The campaign page will display available tasks based on users' regions and product eligibility. Please refer to the campaign page for specific completion requirements and reset rules. Users from restricted regions are not permitted to participate in the Campaign as either inviters or invitees.
When users first visit the campaign page, the system will automatically generate a referral code or select one from their existing referral codes and associate it with this Campaign. Only new users who register through this link / referral code will be counted toward the Campaign.
Inviters should introduce Binance and its products in a fair and responsible manner and must not exert undue pressure on invited users to trade or take other actions.
Binance may disqualify participants and revoke their rewards for dishonest or abusive activities, including using accounts registered from the same IP address or device to abuse the Promotion, bulk-account registrations to farm rewards, or activities involving unlawful, fraudulent or harmful purposes.
Binance may exclude or disqualify users and prevent them from accumulating rewards if they violate Binance’s Terms of Use or other applicable terms, engage in or attempt fraud, manipulate results, fail to satisfy the Promotion requirements, or provide incorrect, outdated, misleading or false information.
Registrations or participation generated through electronic, computerized, digital, robotic, automated, mechanical or similar means for the purpose of automatically or repeatedly reproducing registrations or participation may be invalidated. Binance may invalidate all registrations and participation by a user who engages in such conduct, including those not generated through those means.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.

Venue: Gate
Headline: Welcome Back to Futures: Claim 2 USDT in Cash Daily and Trade to Unlock a 660 USDT Airdrop

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Limited-time rewards are available to returning futures traders who registered through the official website. Trade daily to claim 2 USDT in spot tokens and build your trading volume to unlock an airdrop of up to 660 USDT in spot tokens. Rewards can be combined and are available on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 25, 2026, 10:00 – December 9, 2026, 06:00 (UTC)
## Eligible Participants
This event is open only to users who registered through the official website, have previously traded futures, and have made no futures trades in the 7 × 24 hours immediately before the event starts.
## Event 1: Return to Futures and Claim 2 USDT Daily
After registering for the event, eligible users can earn 2 USDT in spot tokens by reaching a cumulative futures trading volume of at least 10,000 USDT within a check-in day during the event. Each user can receive a maximum of 1 reward per check-in day. A total of 3,000 rewards are available. Rewards are credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
## Event 2: Trade to Unlock an Airdrop of Up to 660 USDT
During the event, users who reach a specified cumulative futures trading volume threshold after registering can unlock the corresponding reward in USDT spot tokens. Each tier has its own task and reward pool, and tier rewards can be combined for a total of up to 660 USDT. The total reward pool is 12,000 USDT. Rewards are credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
Trading Volume | Reward per User (USDT Spot Tokens) | Available Spots
200,000 USDT | 10 USDT | 475 users
1,000,000 USDT | 100 USDT | 45 users
5,000,000 USDT | 550 USDT | 5 users
## Important Notes
Participants must complete identity verification before registering. To register, click [Join Now] on the event page. Due to local policies and service availability, registration and participation are currently unavailable in some regions.
Trading volume = buy volume + sell volume. Only data recorded after registration counts toward this event.
This event is open only to users who signed up through the official website. Users who signed up through other channels cannot register for the event. Eligibility is determined by the information displayed on the event page.
"Returning futures traders" refers to users who, at the time of event registration, have previously traded futures and have made no futures trades in the 7 × 24 hours immediately before the event starts.
[Event 1] Trading check-in period: Each check-in day runs from 00:00:00 (UTC) to 23:59:59 (UTC). Each tracking period counts as 1 check-in day. Reaching the trading volume threshold multiple times within the same check-in day counts as only 1 valid check-in day.
Event rewards are paid in USDT spot tokens and credited automatically to users' accounts after they complete the corresponding tasks. If a reward is not credited, the rewards have either run out or the user does not meet the task requirements.
Users who participate in multiple Gate events of the same type at the same time can receive rewards from only one event.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the event. Prohibited conduct includes repeated participation using multiple accounts, impersonation or submission of false identity verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling onchain funds, coordinating to improperly obtain rewards, repeated fund transfers, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the event. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
Market makers, companies, institutions, affiliates, and users referred by affiliates are not eligible to participate in this event.
Gate retains final authority to interpret the terms of this event.
Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions cannot access some or all services, including participation in this event, games, or contests. For details about restricted regions, read the User Agreement.
